This version reuses one static AI-illustrated pose for the whole body -- only mouth, eyes, and brows are separately overlaid and swappable (same technique as the hand-drawn rig: patch the base art's line with a white rectangle, then redraw the open/blinking/raised version on top). Arm/leg pose swapping isn't available here since there's only one flat image, not separate rigged limbs.

Base character generated via OpenAI's image API instead of hand-tuned SVG paths (see narrator-rig.html for the original fully hand-drawn version). Mouth/eyes/brows still use the same patch-and-redraw overlay technique.
